# Summary

Coda research project.

# Summary Electron desktop shell for visualizing and interacting with coda (ACC design assistant). Displays project, runs, iterations, report, breachs, measures, targets, and platforms. # Docs
📚 Resources: - [Electron](https://www.npmjs.com/package/electron) - `npm` - [Docs](https://www.electronjs.org/docs) - `official` - [API](https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/app) - `reference` - [Electron Forge](https://www.npmjs.com/package/electron-forge) - `npm` - [Docs](https://www.electronforge.io/docs) - `official`
# Specs - MUST mirror semio desktop architecture (Electron Forge, Vite, React, Tailwind). - MUST communicate with coda MCP server via HTTP (streamable-http on 127.0.0.1:8080). - MUST visualize project, runs, iterations, report, breachs, measures, targets, platforms. - MUST allow invoking coda tools: start_run, start_iteration, translate, validate, save_translation, save_report, fix. # Usage 1. Start the coda MCP server (from a coda project root): ```bash cd /path/to/coda-project CODA_PROJECT=$(pwd) uv run --directory ../../coda/py coda.py ``` Or with stdio: `uv run --directory ../../coda/py coda.py --mcp-stdio` (desktop uses HTTP). 2. Run the desktop app: ```bash npm run dev:coda-desktop ``` Or: `cd coda/desktop && npm run dev` 3. Set `CODA_MCP_URL` if the coda server runs on a different host/port (default: `http://127.0.0.1:8080`). # 💯Requirements
